items.title: Banks say Healey is planning to increase tax on their profits in Budget
items.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

items.title: British man fined for causing death of his two-year-old son in Cyprus
items.summary: A British father has been fined €3,000 (£2,500) for causing the death of his two-year-old son when he fell from the fourth floor of a hotel in Cyprus.

items.title: Ten-year-old Willow among children to benefit from pioneering same-day test to spot infections
items.summary: Metagenomics offers a new way of detecting infections in intensive care patients.

items.title: Children aged 5, 8 and 11 killed in US school shooting
items.summary: Four people, including three children, have died after a school shooting in Oregon.

items.title: Reform faces questions over candidate vetting after undercover filming
items.summary: Reform UK says the party has "improved and prioritised its vetting procedures".

items.title: UK to ban three types of extreme pornography next month
items.summary: A ban on pornography depicting strangulation and incestuous relationships - as well as someone pretending to be a child under 16 - will come into effect next month.
